text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle stands out at the Shinzan<n>Kinen with a
powerful run and<n>demonstrates her mastery of
sprints.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With plenty of momentum to spare,<n>her next step is
to clear the main<n>hurdle in the selection
process—clinching the Best Sprinter<n>award.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle enters the NHK Mile<n>Cup—the race that
decides the<n>classic-year King of the Mile.
